subject: Failsafe plan & pilot budget for sales engagement stack
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Failsafe plan & pilot budget for sales engagement stack

Team —

Quick summary: as part of the Q4 cost-efficiency push the GTM ops working group asked us to identify a conservative path to preserve sequence reliability while reducing per-seat spend. The ask from Finance/RevOps: "Can we run a 6-week pilot that demonstrates at least 12% cost per-opportunity savings before committing to a vendor consolidation?"

I expect two parallel tracks: 1) short pilot with Outreach (keep current sequences but test prefix/KV caching + outreach batching) and 2) a narrow trial of Salesloft feature parity for our top-100 reps (safety fallback). The objective is not to rip-and-replace overnight but to build a failsafe strategy that lets Platform tilt traffic for cost when appropriate.

What I need from each of you by EOD Monday:
- Marissa: a vendor-agnostic pilot scope and target rep cohort (suggest 40 sellers).
- Ben: a raw cost spreadsheet with seat vs token line items and our current usage profile (I started one and attached a baseline).
- Lauren: procurement/contract constraints we need to surface (notice windows, termination fees).

Attachment: seq_vendor_costs_q3.xlsx (baseline numbers)

If we can get vendor SOWs and a legal checklist early next week we can lock a pilot start for Oct 25. I will include vendor contacts in the next message so procurement can loop in Legal.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Zhou <clara@outreach.io>, Hannah Jenkins <hannah@hubspot.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Failsafe plan & pilot budget for sales engagement stack

On Sun, Oct 11, 2026 at 09:14, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick summary: as part of the Q4 cost-efficiency push the GTM ops working group asked us to identify a conservative path to preserve sequence reliability while reducing per-seat spend...

Thanks Soojin — attaching a short pilot scope (pilot_scope.docx) and a proposed cohort. TL;DR: 40 sellers (mix of AE/SDR), 6-week run, two arms (control = current Outreach config, experiment = Outreach with KV caching + batched sends + reduced step delays). Secondary parallel: a 2-week migration sandbox for Salesloft to verify critical cadence triggers (email + call logging).

Budget ask: $38k total for pilot (vendor credits + 6 weeks of expanded API usage + engineering support time). If Outreach can provide a credit line that covers 50% of incremental token/API usage we hit Finance's threshold for go/no-go.

Notes for procurement: outreach is open to a time-limited credit; Salesloft is willing to provide a sandbox environment but not an equivalent credit at this stage. Clara and Procurement rep — can you confirm (1) short-form SOW for a 6-week pilot, and (2) whether Outreach will provide a consumption credit?

Attachment: pilot_scope.docx

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Clara Zhou <clara@outreach.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Salesloft <procurement@salesloft.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Failsafe plan & pilot budget for sales engagement stack

Hi Marissa / Soojin / Ben —

Thanks for the clear scope. Outreach can do the following for a 6-week pilot: a) a 60% consumption credit on incremental API usage tied to a signed short-form SOW, b) priority onboarding support (1 product engineer, 12 hours/week) to validate caching/kv changes, and c) a small sandbox for Salesloft comparisons if you want to run the parity checks.

I attached a draft short-form SOW (outreach_sow_draft_v2.pdf) — it includes the credit terms and a 30-day cancellation window during the pilot. Two items to flag: 1) we need anticipated daily send/seq volumes so our backend team can pre-provision test capacity; 2) we require a low-friction data processing addendum to allow non-production logs to be shared for debug.

(Attachment: outreach_sow_draft_v2.pdf)

Action items I can help with immediately: share a simple capacity form you can drop into your spreadsheet, and schedule a short kickoff next week.

— Clara
Clara Zhou
Enterprise Partnerships
Outreach.io

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Failsafe plan & pilot budget for sales engagement stack

Looping Legal and Procurement — see inline.

> Outreach can do the following for a 6-week pilot: a) a 60% consumption credit...

Good win on the credit. A few practical constraints from Procurement/Legal:
- We need a signed short-form SOW with explicit consumption-credit calculation (formula + caps).
- Add a 30-day pilot cancellation clause and confirmation that historical logs used for debugging will be scrubbed of PII.
- If Salesloft sandbox is used, we require a non-production data handling note (no production customer data to be moved).

Proposed next steps:
1) Outreach: please accept the short-form SOW with the credit formula and send a redlined version back by EOD Monday.
2) Marissa: finalize the cohort list and the daily send estimates (drop into the Drive link Clara proposed).
3) Soojin: if we get SOW + cohort by next Tue we can execute procurement sign-off and schedule kickoff for Oct 25.

(Referenced attachments: seq_vendor_costs_q3.xlsx, outreach_sow_draft_v2.pdf, pilot_scope.docx)

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
